header.label: OpenAEC Ecosystem
header.title: Open 3D Viewer
header.desc: Open source 3D viewer for viewing and inspecting BIM models in the browser.

why.title: Why Open 3D Viewer?
why.desc: Viewing BIM models often requires expensive desktop software. Open 3D Viewer offers a lightweight, browser-based 3D viewer that allows anyone to inspect IFC and other 3D models without installation.

webgl.title: WebGL 3D rendering
webgl.desc: Fast 3D rendering in the browser via WebGL. View complex models without plugins or installation.

import.title: IFC/STEP/OBJ import
import.desc: Support for commonly used 3D formats including IFC, STEP and OBJ. Drag and drop files directly into the viewer.

selection.title: Properties and layers
selection.desc: Click a model to see its file, vertex and triangle counts and bounding box. Switch layers on or off one by one.

clipping.title: Sections & clipping planes
clipping.desc: Create cross-sections through the model with clipping planes. View internal constructions and hidden elements.

measure.title: Measurement tools
measure.desc: Measure distances and angles straight in the 3D model and view the model statistics.

multiformat.title: More than twenty formats
multiformat.desc: GLB, OBJ, STL, FBX, SKP, STEP, DXF, IFC, 3MF, DAE, PLY, PCD, WRL, XYZ, VTK, G-code, KMZ, VOX, AMF, BLEND, IGES and more, including point clouds.

modes.title: Display modes
modes.desc: Solid, wireframe, points or hidden line, with grid, ambient light and standard views.
